note: RV park among tall pines in Paradise, with gravel and asphalt pads on paved roads, back-in and pull-through sites, an on-site manager and 16 vehicle-storage spaces. Rigs may be up to 20 years old (management may make exceptions); generators and open fires are not allowed, dogs must be 40 lb or under, and a second pet costs $25 per stay. Month-to-month rentals run $550 to $650. The office is closed on Sundays. --Claude
